evidence.exportsMap: The exports map contains no collection/store/typeahead/selection helpers: no ./internals/useListData, no ./internals/useTypeahead, no Selection/Key type export. The complete helper surface is the 34 ./internals/* subpaths listed in _base-ui-1.8.0-export-surface.json.
evidence.shared: see the shared evidence block: docs index lists only four utilities (CSP Provider, Direction Provider, mergeProps, useRender) — no collection or data-store utility.

partialReplacements.Selection/Key types: No equivalent; Base UI values are plain (`any`/generic `Value`), and selection is expressed per component (e.g. Combobox `value` + `isItemEqualToValue`, Select `value`).
partialReplacements.useListData/ListData: No equivalent. The closest shipped capability is component-level: Combobox 1.8.0 exports createItems/createComboboxItems, useFilter, useFilteredItems and the ComboboxItemCollection type (combobox/index.parts.d.ts, items/createItems.d.ts) for deriving value+label from source items, plus internals/filter's getFilter({locale, ...Intl.CollatorOptions}) containing/startingWith/endingWith — but these are filter/derivation helpers, not a mutable list store.
partialReplacements.useDateFormatter/DateValue/CalendarDate/: No equivalent (see the date records): Base UI ships no date formatting or locale hook; use Intl.DateTimeFormat and the repo's existing @internationalized/date utilities directly.

affectedRepoFiles: registry/untitledui/components/base/select/tag-select.tsx (imports useListData + type ListData from react-stately, plus AriaComboBox/AriaGroup/AriaInput/AriaListBox/ComboBoxStateContext)
consequence: NO_BASE_UI_EQUIVALENT for the store/collection helpers. Widgets that depend on them (tag-select, tags, tag inputs) cannot be migrated mechanically: Base UI has no list store, so the data layer must be rewritten on React state (or kept on react-stately) even where a visual component (e.g. Base UI Combobox/Select with chips) exists. useControlledState has no Base UI export either — but it is trivially replaceable by a local useState/useMemo shim, and Base UI's own controlled convention (value/defaultValue/onValueChange) should be used instead.
notableDifferences: react-stately's useListData gives an immutable list store (items/getItem/insert/remove/move/filter + selection); Base UI deliberately keeps state in the consumer's hands. Any Base UI migration of tag/collection widgets must port that state management to the app or to component-level APIs.

React Aria's Selection/Key (Set<Key> | 'all') has no Base UI analogue; Base UI components express single/multiple selection through their own value types and item-equality props (isItemEqualToValue), with data-attribute state on items.
react-aria's useFocusManager (used in nav-account-card.tsx) has no equivalent; focus movement in Base UI is internal to composite/popup components.
